items.title: Animated Armor
items.html:
Animated Armor

ASI: +1 CON

Speed: (See Subrace)

Size: Your size is determined by the size of armor you inhabit.

Alignment: Lawful

No Eyes: You have blindsight of 60ft but are blind beyond this radius

Construct: You are a sentient suit of armor, you do not age like normal living beings. You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition and you are also immune to disease. You do not need to eat, drink or breathe. You also cannot be targeted by spells that target humanoids like hold person or cure wounds. You also do not sleep, but rather you stay in an inactive state for 4 hours a day, during this time you are fully aware of your surroundings.

Mendable: Whenever the spell mending is cast on you, regain 1d6+ spell casting ability hit points.

Antimagic Susceptibility: You have disadvantage in skill checks and attack rolls while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, you must succeed on a constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

False Appearance: While you remain motionless, you are indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

Soul Transfer: You can transfer your consciousness into another suit of armor over the course of a short or long rest. During that time you perform an hour-long ritual. Over the course of that hour, you must remain within 5 feet of the armor, or the ritual fails. This change may alter your subrace accordingly, based on the desired armor type. If you are not proficient in the armor you transfer yourself into, you will receive all the detriments that someone normally would by wearing a set of armor they are not proficient with, as well as a -2 penalty to your Armor Class.

Armor Slam: As a suit of armor, you are able to put a lot of energy into a full body slam. As an action, you can deal 1d10 + Con bludgeoning damage to a creature within 5 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your constitution modifier and you regain all uses after a short or long rest.

Empty Armor: You are a hollow suit of armor, if the DM allows, a creature of your size can wear you as armor. In order for a creature to wear you as armor, it must have the same limb structure as you. When you or the creature wearing you takes damage, split the damage evenly between you, you take the higher number. You can make a creature not proficient in your armor type proficient while wearing you, you can also make them experience the detriments as if they are not. As an action, you can force an unwilling creature you are grappling to wear you, make another grapple check, on a success you force them to wear you.

Languages: You know common and one additional language your creator knew.

Subrace: Your subrace is determined by your armor type. Your AC is determined by the type of armor you are, as if you were wearing it. You can use unarmored defense instead of the AC gained by your armor type but they cannot stack.

Light:

ASI: +2 to Dex
Light Feet: Your walking speed is 35ft

Medium:

ASI:+2 to Dex or +2 to Str
Speed: 30ft
Skilled: Gain proficiency in any two skills of your choice.

Heavy:

ASI: +2 to Str or +1 to Str/+1 to Con
Heavy Footed: Your movement speed is 25 feet but you have advantage on saving throws against pushing/pulling effects like shoving and the thorn whip cantrip.
Heavy Fists: Your fists are as heavy as your feet, you can add your strength modifier to the damage of your armor slam.

items.title: Animated Baby Doll
items.html:
Animated Baby Doll

Ability score increase:
Increase your dexterity score by 2 and your charisma score by 1.

Alignment:
Just like a normal baby, baby dolls are highly unpredictable and tend toward chaotic alignments.

Size:
You're an animated doll, your size is tiny.

Darkvision:
You have 60ft of darkvision

Created, Not Born:
You were a doll animated by magic, therefore you are a construct, not a humanoid. Because of this, you do not age. Also, you are unaffected by spells that target humanoids such as hold person and crown of madness. You are also immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Unfortunately healing spells like cure wounds do not work on you. Because you are a construct, you also do not need to eat, drink, breath, or sleep. Instead of sleeping, you must remain in an inactive state for 4 hours a day to gain the benefits of a long rest, remaining conscious and alert to danger during this time.

Mendable
When a creature casts mending on you, they can expend one spell slot, causing you to regain 2d8 hit points per spell slot level expended. If you have 0 hit points you also become stable.

Did that doll just move?
While completely motionless, you are indistinguishable from a normal doll.

Holy crap that doll is fast:
Unlike a human baby, baby dolls are quite fast for their size, you have a walking speed of 30 ft and crawling does not cost you extra movement.

Skill proficiencies.
You are proficient in perception and intimidation.

Languages:
You can speak, read and write common and one other language that your creator spoke.

Trapped Soul:

(At DM's Discretion)

Your life force is not tethered to your body, even when your body dies, your soul lives on. If you die, a creature can place your head (assuming it's intact) near a body-like object (ex: suit of armor, headless body) and cast mending, expending a 3rd level, attaching your head to the object. The object then becomes your new body, if this object is made of organic matter, it can no longer decompose until you die.

items.title: Cartoon
items.html:
Cartoon

Legacy:
Choose a race to base your appearance off of, if said race gives you a climbing, burrowing, swimming or flying speed, you gain this speed.

Ability Score Increase.
Increase your charisma score by 2 and your dexterity score by 1.

Size:
Your size is medium or small

Speed:
30ft

Timeless:
You are a cartoon, you do not age.

Mischievous:
As a mischievous character you gain proficiency in deception and performance skills.

Rubbery:
You have resistance to bludgeoning damage and can squeeze through spaces as if you were one size smaller.

Speedy Escape:
When you move on your turn you can choose to double your movement speed until the end of that turn. You can't use this feature until you move 0ft on one of your turns.

Extra-dimensional Backpack:
You have access to a pocket dimension located behind your back. This pocket dimension is a 3 foot cube and is weightless regardless of its contents. Only you can retrieve items from this pocket dimension. When you retrieve an item from your pocket dimension, roll a d20, on a 1 you pull out the wrong item.

Graffiti artist:(LVL3)
As an action, you can pull out a magical spray can and paint a doorway on a flat surface. You can open this door as if it were a normal door and walk inside. Only you can pass through this doorway. The inside of this pocket dimension is a 10ft cube and lasts for 1 minute. While in the pocket dimension you have total cover against all attacks and spells coming from outside the door. Also while in the pocket dimension, you can use a bonus action to appear in an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 ft of the doorway. You can use this feature once per long rest.

Legends Never Die:(LVL10)
You have advantage on death saving throws.

items.title: Harambe
items.html:
Harambe

Harambes started out as a normal group of gorillas, but over time they grew in intelligence, then a harambe cast the mage hand cantrip and used it to grab a banana out of a tree. After this point the intelligence of the species grew dramatically as well as their expertise of the mage hand cantrip. Eventually they learned how to become quadrupedal using the cantrip. As their intelligence grew, their society developed nearly as quickly. A society with not so much rules as an understanding of what is, and what isn't allowed. Harambes live in tribes though they are not as solid as most species tribes are as harambes are allowed to freely move between tribes, so small tribes act as towns and large tribes act as cities. When a harambe does something that is believed as wrong they must have 2 accusers, if there are 2 accusers, then the accusers and defendants must each write an essay to plead their case, send it to the people of the tribe, then write one more essay in response to the opposing side's essay and send it to the people of the tribe. One week after the second essay has been released, any who wish may vote for which side they believe more, if the accusers win, then the tribe elders choose a punishment, otherwise the defendants are free to go.

ASI. Your Intelligence increases by 2 and your Constitution by 1.

AGE. Harambes live to the age of exactly 100 unless they are killed beforehand.

Alignment. Most harambes lean towards chaotic and good, believing in morality over law.

Size. Harambes are taller and heavier than humans, standing at about 7 feet tall and averaging 450 pounds, your size is medium.
Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

Magic Monkey. You know the Mage Hand cantrip. In addition you can have a number of mage hands at the same time equal to half your level.

Power Hand. You have 2 powerful mage hands that don't count against your mage hand count. These mage hands have a range of 120 ft, their durations are until dispelled, and can carry up to 5 times your level pounds. At level 5 these mage hands can attack and activate magic items. You can also attach these mage hands to yourself to become quadrupedal, increasing your movement speed by 10 feet.
Powerful Build. You count as one size large when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

items.title: Variant Humans (Another One)
items.html:
Variant Humans (Another One)

Proficiency Increase. Increase your proficiency bonus by 1.
Size. Medium
Speed. 30 ft
Subspecies

Half-Breed

Half-Human. Choose one feature from another allowed species that is not an ASI. Gain that feature.

Pureblood

Focused. When you fail a skill check that you are proficient in, you may double your proficiency bonus for that check. Once you use this ability you may not use it again until you complete a long rest.

items.title: Cloud Elf
items.html:
Cloud Elf (2014)

Living in cities and palaces made of clouds in just about anywhere in the material plane and the elemental plane of air. Cloud elves are very mistaken for air genasi by anyone who hasn't seen either, but are obviously elves to others. Sometimes a cloud elf colony is close to a tall mountain they generally then have good relations with or even live with aarakocra or goliaths. Occasionally you can find a cloud elf run monastery with a few non cloud elves. If a cloud elf lives away from a cloud elf society they prefer secluded lives or in a small cloud elf group.
Cloud elves tend to have white or gray toned skin with white, gray or black hair. Their eyes are generally blue or green. Cloud elves are very slim and rarely weigh more than 100 pounds.

Ability Score Increase
One score of your choice increases by one

Weapon training
Unlike regular elves cloud elves prefer only ranged weapons.
You have proficiency with the shortbow, longbow, and all crossbows (light, hand, and heavy).
At the DM's discretion you also can have proficiency in all guns.

Slow falling
When you are falling you can cast levitate on yourself, descending only. You can use this feature twice per long rest.

Fleet of foot
Cloud elves being more swept by the wind increases your base walking speed to 35 feet.

Background
Cloud elves either have a background relating to being secluded or from a big city.

Alignment
Cloud elves tend toward neutral alignments for being part of their own civilizations. They tend not to have many relationships with other races or even other elf subraces.


Cloud Elf (2024)

Level
1st 3rd 5th
Your speed increases to 35ft. You also know the gust cantrip. Feather fall Levitate

items.title: The Sentinel
items.html:
The Sentinel

Background: Sentinels are statues animated by powerful magic, most commonly used to guard the tombs and burial grounds of kings and queens. Because they do not age, Sentinels can guard burial grounds for hundreds of years. However during this time some Sentinels abandon their post and try to find a place among civilization.

ASI: +2 Con +1 Str

Speed: 30ft

Size: Medium

Alignment: Lawful

Tremorsense: you have 30ft of Tremorsense.

Keen Sight: You have advantage on perception checks relying on sight

Construct: Sentinels are statues brought to life by powerful magic, thus you are not living. You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition and you are also immune to disease. You do not need to eat, drink or breathe and you do not age. You also cannot be targeted by spells that target humanoids like hold person or cure wounds. You also do not sleep, but rather you stay in an inactive state for 4 hours a day, during this time you are fully aware of your surroundings.

Mendable: Whenever the spell mending is cast on you, regain 1d6 + spell casting ability hit points.

Antimagic Susceptibility: You have disadvantage in skill checks and attack rolls while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, you must succeed on a constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

False Appearance: While you remain motionless, you are indistinguishable from a statue.

Tough Skin: You can use constitution instead of dexterity when determining AC and while unarmored your AC is 13+CON.
